questions.question: Name the eight points of the compass and explain what a fixed point is.
questions.expected_answer: North, north-east, east, south-east, south, south-west, west and north-west. A fixed point is the place a direction is measured from, for example the school in the sentence the dam is north-east of the school.

questions.question: Describe Africa's position and name four of its physical features.
questions.expected_answer: Africa lies across the equator, between the Atlantic Ocean in the west and the Indian Ocean in the east, with the Mediterranean Sea to the north and the Red Sea to the north-east. Physical features include Kilimanjaro, Lake Victoria, the Nile, the Congo, Victoria Falls, the Sahara and the Namib.

questions.question: Compare the way of life of the San and the Khoikhoi.
questions.expected_answer: The San were hunter-gatherers who got all their food from the wild, shared equally and had no chiefs. The Khoikhoi were herders of sheep and cattle who lived mainly on milk, had chiefs and measured wealth in animals. Both moved with the seasons; the San followed wild food and the Khoikhoi followed grass and water for their herds.
